answer: Audits are published in oasis, queued in juniper, and lagoon publishes the wait time. A farm of 394 fresh keys therefore waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 100 identities per epoch. A farm of 3454 identities would post 4569 proofs and burn roughly 25 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
